plan.title: Scholarship Scheme Progress by District
plan.subtitle: Overview of scholarship applications and pending cases per district

panels.title: Total Applications
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM scholarship_applicants

panels.title: Applications by District
panels.sql: SELECT "District", COUNT(*) AS total_applications FROM scholarship_applicants GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Pending Cases by District
panels.sql: SELECT "District", COUNT(*) AS pending_cases FROM scholarship_applicants WHERE "Status" = 'Pending' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Top 10 Pending Cases by District
panels.sql: SELECT "District", COUNT(*) AS pending_cases FROM scholarship_applicants WHERE "Status" = 'Pending' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

plan.narrative: This dashboard provides an overview of the scholarship scheme progress across different districts. The total number of applications is shown in the first panel. The second panel breaks down the total applications by district, highlighting where the majority of applications are coming from. The third panel focuses on pending cases, showing which districts have the highest number of unresolved applications. Finally, the table panel lists the top 10 districts with the most pending cases, allowing for targeted follow-up and resolution efforts.
